label: Photography
tagline: Curated photography-style art-direction for raster-photo slots
description: Picks photography styles for raster-photo slots BEFORE visual-orchestrator's per-medium dispatch fires. Reads docs/research/photography-library.md (42 curated styles: editorial-fashion / street / documentary / product / food / lifestyle / fine-art / conceptual + Y2K-halftone / golden-hour / night-flash / chrome-hearts-editorial / Helmut-Newton-flash / Tillmans-candid / Sorrenti-grain / GenZ-flash-disposable / Apple-clean-studio / Aesop-apothecary / Bon-Appetit-food and others). For each photographic slot, picks one primary + optional secondary style by consulting the library's decision tree against the committed prototype.md aesthetic, writes a prompt-enrichment node (pe_photo_<slotId>) whose outputs include the full prompt, negative-prompt, film-stock hint, lens hint, lighting hint, mood hint. Visual-orchestrator reads these enrichments when dispatching the raster-photo per-medium drawer. OPTIONAL — fires only when (a) at least one slot will resolve to raster-photo AND (b) an image-generation skill is wired to the project. If either condition fails, returns runStatus:error and visual-orchestrator falls back to default un-enriched prompts. Cold-isolated per project. Same trigger shape as visual-orchestrator (FIRST-style, runs against source the moment HTML is scaffolded), but scoped to photographic slots only.

triggers.title: Photo art-direction pass (BEFORE visual-orchestrator)
triggers.rule: After source HTML is scaffolded (by /prototype skill or top-level Claude), BEFORE visual-orchestrator's per-medium dispatch fires, chat-Claude dispatches photography-orchestrator IF (a) at least one slot in the source will resolve to raster-photo medium (explicit data-medium attribute OR surrounding aesthetic demands photography per the library decision tree — recipe-editorial-magazine, recipe-lookbook, recipe-warm-restraint, recipe-bento-marketing, aesthetic-coastal-grandmother, aesthetic-dark-academia, aesthetic-cottagecore with photo, aesthetic-y2k-futurism, style-cream-humanist, style-serif-warm-paper, etc.) AND (b) an image-generation model is wired into the project (a working image-gen skill registered via /__capabilities). Also fires on explicit user request naming a photographer / magazine / photo style ("Helmut Newton flash" / "Chrome Hearts editorial" / "GenZ flash" / "Wolfgang Tillmans candid" / "golden hour cinematic" / "Y2K halftone"). One consistent flow. If conditions fail, returns runStatus:error and visual-orchestrator proceeds with default prompts.
